title: A Rule and Its Reasons
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空事例。実在の政策、医療助言、教育効果、調査結果ではない。台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A rule can simplify decisions within an institution by specifying in advance how people are expected to act in a particular kind of situation.
sentences.ja: 規則は特定種類の状況で人がどう行動すべきかを事前に定め、組織内の判断を簡単にできる。

sentences.en: Its general wording may also help individuals understand what will be required of them without having to negotiate a new arrangement every time they encounter a familiar problem.
sentences.ja: 一般的な文言は、身近な問題に出会うたび新たな仕組みを交渉せず、自身に何が求められるか理解する助けにもなり得る。

sentences.en: However, applying an established rule may become difficult when a new situation differs in a relevant respect from the situations that originally motivated the rule.
sentences.ja: しかし新状況が規則の当初の動機となった状況と重要な点で異なると、既定規則の適用が困難になることがある。

sentences.en: The challenge concerns the relationship between the consistency of a decision-making process and the ability of an institution to respond to circumstances that were not initially anticipated.
sentences.ja: 課題は意思決定過程の一貫性と当初予想されなかった事情に対応する制度の能力との関係に関わる。

sentences.en: Imagine a fictional community center that requires groups using its facilities to submit a request several days before their planned activity.
sentences.ja: 施設を使う集団に予定活動の数日前に依頼を出すよう求める架空地域センターを想像しよう。

sentences.en: The requirement was introduced because staff members needed sufficient time to determine whether suitable rooms and equipment would be available.
sentences.ja: 要件は職員が適切な部屋・機器を利用できるか判断する十分な時間を必要としたため導入された。

sentences.en: One day, a local organization asks to use a room on short notice after the unexpected closure of the location where its activity had originally been scheduled.
sentences.ja: ある日地元組織が当初予定した場所が予期せず閉鎖された後、急な連絡で部屋を使わせてほしいと頼む。

sentences.en: The staff discover that the requested room is available and that preparing it would require relatively little additional work.
sentences.ja: 職員は希望部屋が空いており準備に比較的少ない追加作業しか必要ないと発見する。

sentences.en: Some staff members therefore question whether rejecting the request solely because it was submitted late would contribute to the purpose for which the original requirement was established.
sentences.ja: そこで一部職員は遅く提出されたことだけを理由に拒否することが、当初要件の目的に貢献するか疑問視する。

sentences.en: Other staff members express concern that granting an exception without explaining the grounds for it could create uncertainty for organizations that had previously followed the established procedure.
sentences.ja: 他職員は根拠を説明せず例外を認めると、以前既定手順に従った組織に不確実性を生むと懸念する。

sentences.en: Those organizations might reasonably wish to know whether the same opportunity would be available to them if they encountered comparable circumstances.
sentences.ja: それらの組織は比較可能な事情に遭遇した際同じ機会を得られるか合理的に知りたいかもしれない。

sentences.en: The staff begin considering which features of the particular request are relevant to the purpose of the rule and which are merely accidental features of the current situation.
sentences.ja: 職員は特定依頼のどの特徴が規則の目的に関連し、どれが現状の偶然の特徴にすぎないかを検討し始める。

sentences.en: They recognize that an exception based on an identified principle differs from an exception granted solely because a particular applicant is familiar to the decision-maker.
sentences.ja: 特定原則に基づく例外は申請者が判断者に親しいことだけを理由に認める例外とは異なると認識する。

sentences.en: The fictional center considers establishing a procedure through which unusual requests could be examined according to clearly identified conditions.
sentences.ja: 架空センターは明確に特定された条件に従い珍しい依頼を検討できる手順の確立を考える。

sentences.en: Such a procedure might specify the kinds of circumstances that warrant further consideration without guaranteeing that every late request will be accepted.
sentences.ja: 手順は全遅延依頼の受理を保証せず、追加検討に値する事情の種類を定め得る。

sentences.en: The staff would still have to examine the practical consequences of granting a request and the obligations associated with their existing commitments.
sentences.ja: 職員はなお依頼承認の実務影響と既存の約束に伴う義務を調べる必要がある。

sentences.en: The example does not establish legal requirements for any real institution; it illustrates a general problem concerning the justification of decisions.
sentences.ja: 例は実在組織の法的要件を確立するものでなく判断の正当化についての一般的問題を例示する。

sentences.en: It could also require a brief record of the reasons for each decision.
sentences.ja: また各判断の理由を簡潔に記録することを求めるかもしれない。

sentences.en: Consistency does not always require treating situations that differ in relevant ways as though they were identical.
sentences.ja: 一貫性は重要な点で異なる状況を同一であるかのように扱うことを常に求めない。

sentences.en: Nor does responsiveness necessarily justify abandoning a general requirement whenever a particular applicant would benefit from an exception.
sentences.ja: 対応性も、特定申請者が例外から利益を得るたび一般要件を放棄することを必ずしも正当化しない。

sentences.en: A reasoned decision requires attention to both the purpose of an existing rule and the grounds on which a departure from its usual application might be justified.
sentences.ja: 理由ある判断には既存規則の目的と通常適用からの逸脱が正当化され得る根拠の両方への注意が必要である。

sentences.en: The value of a rule may depend partly on the ability of an institution to explain why it applies in some circumstances and why a different response is appropriate in others.
sentences.ja: 規則の価値は、ある事情に適用され、別事情では異なる対応が適切な理由を組織が説明できる能力にも依存するかもしれない。

vocabulary.definition: gave someone a reason to act
case excluded from a general rule
things one is expected to do

questions.prompt: Why can an established rule become difficult to apply?
options: New circumstances may differ in ways relevant to its purpose.
Every rule is necessarily unclear.
Institutions have no familiar situations.
Rules cannot guide decisions consistently.
questions.explanation_ja: 目的に関わる条件の変化。

questions.prompt: Why was the advance request requirement introduced?
options: The center wanted to reject every local organization.
Every room was permanently occupied.
Staff needed time to check the availability of suitable facilities.
All equipment needed to be newly purchased.

questions.prompt: Why do some staff question strict application of the rule?
options: The request was actually submitted early.
The rule has already been abolished.
The applicant has formally challenged every rule.
The room is available and preparation requires little extra work.

questions.prompt: What concern do other staff members raise?
options: The room is not suitable for the activity.
Unexplained exceptions could create uncertainty for other organizations.
The center has no reservation procedure.
The original rule was never communicated.

questions.prompt: Why should the decision-maker identify relevant features of the request?
options: To distinguish principled exceptions from favoritism.
To guarantee that every applicant knows the staff personally.
To ignore the original purpose of the rule.
To avoid explaining any decision.
questions.explanation_ja: 根拠ある例外と特別扱い。

options: Automatically accept all late requests.
Reject every request regardless of circumstances.
A way to examine unusual requests against clearly specified conditions.
Make every request a new legal proceeding.

questions.prompt: Why would a possible exception still require further examination?
options: Every exception necessarily violates the original rule's purpose.
Accepting it may affect existing commitments and practical obligations.
The center has no other activities.
Every request must achieve an identical outcome.

questions.prompt: What view of consistency is expressed?
options: Consistency means accepting all requests.
Consistency requires identical action regardless of circumstances.
Consistency is irrelevant to institutional decisions.
Relevant differences can justify different treatment under a consistent principle.
Prevent someone from taking action.
Describe a completed event.
Provide sufficient reason for further action.
Guarantee a desired result.

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the argument?
options: Institutions should relate rules and possible exceptions to their purposes and explainable grounds.
Every exception demonstrates unfairness.
Any request benefiting an applicant should override a rule.
Rules should never be applied to unfamiliar situations.
questions.explanation_ja: 目的と説明可能な根拠。

grammar.focus: without having to negotiate a new arrangement
for which the original requirement was established
grammar.explanation_ja: 前置詞＋関係代名詞、受動態。

paraphrases.source: Its general wording may also help individuals understand what will be required of them without having to negotiate a new arrangement every time they encounter a familiar problem.
paraphrases.rewrite: General rules can reduce the need to negotiate repeatedly.

paraphrases.source: Some staff members therefore question whether rejecting the request solely because it was submitted late would contribute to the purpose for which the original requirement was established.
paraphrases.rewrite: Staff question whether rejecting the request would serve the original purpose of the rule.

paraphrases.source: Those organizations might reasonably wish to know whether the same opportunity would be available to them if they encountered comparable circumstances.
paraphrases.rewrite: Other organizations might want the same opportunity under similar conditions.

paraphrases.source: Nor does responsiveness necessarily justify abandoning a general requirement whenever a particular applicant would benefit from an exception.
paraphrases.rewrite: Being responsive does not automatically justify ignoring a general requirement.
